expanded_summary.before: Delta-tocopherol is one of the naturally occurring tocopherols in the vitamin E family. It is fat-soluble and can help slow oxidation.
expanded_summary.after: Synthetic delta-tocopherol is a manufactured form of one of the tocopherols in the vitamin E family. In the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code it is listed as synthetic delta-tocopherol (309), distinct from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b). It is fat-soluble and is used as an antioxidant in fat-containing foods.
